header: Machine learning for Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
ML Commons is an OpenSearch plugin that provides a set of common machine learning (ML)
algorithms through transport and REST API calls. Those calls choose the right nodes and resources
for each ML request and monitors ML tasks to ensure uptime. This allows you to leverage existing
open-source ML algorithms and reduce the eﬀort required to develop new ML features. For more
about the plugin, see Machine learning in the OpenSearch documentation. This chapter covers how
to use the plugin with Amazon OpenSearch Service.
